1.stem_plain: Due to the heavy rain yesterday, there __________ a flood along Tanglin Road.

2.stem_plain: My parents __________ proud of me when I helped the old lady cross the road.

3.stem_plain: "Do not disturb your brother. He __________ for his examination now," Mother reminded me.

4.stem_plain: The boy stared in awe as __________ eagle from the far end of the park flew towards him.

5.stem_plain: Last week, the pupils __________ an enrichment programme on how to develop good study habits.

6.stem_plain: When we __________ the stadium after the football match, it started to rain.

7.stem_plain: The burglar entered the house __________ the window.

8.stem_plain: I decided not to see the doctor as there were __________ people waiting in the clinic.

9.stem_plain: This poster is both colourful __________ interesting. It caught my eye the moment I saw it.

10.stem_plain: The dessert is too sweet, it has too __________ sugar in it.

1.zh: 由于昨天的大雨，东陵路沿线发生了洪水。
1.note: “yesterday”（昨天）提示过去时间，且 “a flood”（一场洪水）为单数名词，因此系动词使用单数过去式 was。
1.concept: There be 句型与一般过去时 — There be Structure & Simple Past Tense

2.zh: 当我帮助那位老奶奶过马路时，我的父母为我感到自豪。
2.note: “helped” 提示时间为过去，“My parents”（我的父母）是复数主语，因此使用复数过去式系动词 were。
2.concept: 主谓一致与一般过去时 — Subject-Verb Agreement & Simple Past Tense

3.zh: “不要打扰你哥哥。他现在正在为考试复习，”母亲提醒我。
3.note: 时间状语 “now”（现在）明确提示动作正在进行，因此动词使用现在进行时 is studying。
3.concept: 现在进行时 — Present Continuous Tense

4.zh: 当那只来自公园远端的鹰向他飞来时，小男孩惊叹地注视着。
4.note: “eagle” 是单数名词，且 “from the far end of the park”（从公园的远端）提示空间距离较远，因此使用表示单数远称的指示代词 that。
4.concept: 指示代词 — Demonstrative Pronouns — that

5.zh: 上周，学生们参加了一项关于如何养成良好学习习惯的拓展课程。
5.note: “Last week”（上周）明确提示过去时间，因此谓语动词使用一般过去式 attended。
5.concept: 一般过去时 — Simple Past Tense

6.zh: 当我们离开体育场时，天开始下雨了。
6.note: 这里描述一个过去正在进行的背景动作（离开体育场时）被另一个突发动作（开始下雨）所中断，因此使用过去进行时 were leaving。
6.concept: 过去进行时 — Past Continuous Tense

7.zh: 窃贼穿过窗户进入了房子。
7.note: “through” 表示“穿过、通过”某个立体的空间（如窗户、森林、隧道等）。
7.concept: 空间介词 — Prepositions of Place — through

8.zh: 我决定不看医生了，因为诊所里有很多人在等待。
8.note: “decided not to see the doctor”（决定不看医生）说明人太多不想排队，“people” 是可数名词复数，因此选用 many 修饰。
8.concept: 修饰可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Countable Nouns — many

9.zh: 这张海报既色彩鲜艳又有趣。我一看到它就被吸引住了。
9.note: “both ... and ...” 是固定关联连词搭配，意为“既……又……”。
9.concept: 并列连词固定搭配 — Correlative Conjunctions — both...and

10.zh: 这道甜点太甜了，里面的糖太多了。
10.note: “sugar”（糖）是不可数名词，且根据前面“太甜了”的语境，表示“太多”时要用 “too much” 来修饰。
10.concept: 修饰不可数名词的量词 — Quantifiers with Uncountable Nouns — too much

11.stem_plain: The sailors abandoned the ship when it started to __________ in the heavy storm.

12.stem_plain: The main __________ for making ice cream are sugar, cream and vanilla essence.

13.stem_plain: "Stop taking my stationery without my permission!" Andy __________ angrily.

14.stem_plain: The two men who jumped into the water to save the child were given an award for their __________ act.

15.stem_plain: Before the start of the race, the __________ did some warm-up exercises.

16.stem_plain: Jack was __________ when he spotted a snake slithering in the garden.

11.zh: 当船在强暴风雨中开始下沉时，海员们遗弃了这艘船。
11.note: “ship”（船）在暴风雨中面临的危险是下沉，选用动词 “sink”（下沉、沉没）。
11.concept: 动词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — sink

choices.eg: The autumn leaves fall from the trees and cover the green lawn.
Be careful not to drop the fragile porcelain plates on the floor.
The heavy stone managed to sink quickly straight to the bottom of the lake.
They plan to hang the new family painting in the living room.

12.zh: 制作冰淇淋的主要原料是糖、奶油和香草精。
12.note: 后文列出的糖（sugar）、奶油（cream）等都是制作食品所需的材料，选用名词 “ingredients”（原料、配料）。
12.concept: 名词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — ingredients

choices.eg: Please read the operating instructions carefully before using the microwave.
Mix all the ingredients thoroughly in a large bowl before baking.
The shop sells mobile phone accessories such as leather cases and chargers.
The athletes brought their own sports equipment for the training session.

13.zh: “别不经我允许就拿我的文具！”安迪愤怒地吼道。
13.note: 带有感叹号的直接引语以及副词 “angrily”（愤怒地）都提示说活的声音非常大，选用动词 “yelled”（大喊、吼叫）。
13.concept: 说话类动词辨析 — Vocabulary (Verbs) — yelled

choices.eg: The coach yelled instructions to his players from the sidelines.
With a sore throat, he croaked a faint hello into the telephone.
She mumbled an apology and walked away quickly with her head down.
The library visitors whispered quietly to avoid disturbing other readers.

14.zh: 那两个跳进水里救孩子的男子因他们的勇敢行为而获得了表彰。
14.note: “jumped into the water to save the child”（跳水救人）属于典型的见义勇为，选用形容词 “brave”（勇敢的）来修饰行为（act）。
14.concept: 形容词词义辨析 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — brave

choices.eg: The brave firefighter rushed into the burning house to save the baby.
An honest boy returned the wallet he found on the street to the police.
Thanks to her diligent study habits, she topped the national examinations.
The intelligent student solved the complex puzzle within a few seconds.

15.zh: 在比赛开始前，参赛选手们做了一些热身运动。
15.note: “start of the race”（比赛开始）以及 “warm-up exercises”（热身运动）的执行者一定是亲自参加比赛的人，选用名词 “competitors”（参赛者）。
15.concept: 名词词义辨析与场景对应 — Vocabulary (Nouns) — competitors

choices.eg: The enthusiastic audience clapped loudly at the end of the concert.
The tennis star respected his opponents and always shook hands after matches.
Thousands of spectators packed the stadium to watch the final football match.
All competitors must report to the registry counter before the race starts.

16.zh: 当杰克发现一条蛇在花园里爬行时，他吓了一跳。
16.note: 看到蛇（snake slithering）通常会引发意外的惊吓或恐惧感，选用形容词 “shocked”（震惊的、受惊吓的）。
16.concept: 形容词词义辨析与常理推断 — Vocabulary (Adjectives) — shocked

choices.eg: He was highly annoyed by the loud barking of the neighbor's dog all night.
She was shocked to hear the unexpected news of her friend's sudden departure.
The boy felt ashamed for telling a lie to his parents about the test score.
They were deeply disappointed when their holiday trip was postponed due to bad weather.

21.stem_plain: According to the visual text, the main purpose is to ________.

21.note: 解释为什么选这个答案 — replace stems, passages, and teaching copy when content is ready.

17.note: 指代“李夫人（Mrs Lee）的手”。Mrs Lee是女性，修饰名词hands，故使用女性形容词性物主代词“her”（她的）。

18.note: 指代“学生们（The students）”。在句中作had done well的主语，由于是复数概念，故使用人称代词主格“they”（他们）。

19.note: 指代“学生们（The students）的成绩”。修饰名词results，因为是指代复数群体的所有物，故使用复数形容词性物主代词“their”（他们的）。

20.note: 这是李夫人对全班学生（The class）说的话：“你们应该为你们的努力付出得到回报而感到自豪。”修饰名词短语hard work，故使用第二人称形容词性物主代词“your”（你们的）。

cloze: The students greeted Mrs Lee when she stepped into the classroom. She was holding a stack of test papers in [Q17] hands. Mrs Lee told the class that [Q18] had done well in the recent test. The students were overjoyed upon receiving [Q19] results. "You should be proud that [Q20] hard work has paid off," Mrs Lee said with a smile.
zh: 当李夫人走进教室时，学生们向她问好。她手里拿着一叠试卷。李夫人告诉全班同学，他们在最近的测试中表现得很好。学生们在收到他们的成绩时欣喜若狂。“你们应该为你们的努力付出得到回报而感到自豪，”李夫人笑着说。

28.stem_plain: Justin was selected for the contest. Jane was selected for the contest too.

29.stem_plain: Check your work carefully. You do not want to make careless mistakes.

28.zh: 贾斯汀和珍都被选中参加比赛。
28.note: ‘Both ... and ...’ 连接两个单数主语时，谓语动词要用复数形式（was 变为 were）。
28.answer: Both Justin and Jane were selected for the contest.

29.zh: 如果你不想犯粗心的错误，请仔细检查你的工作。
29.note: 使用‘if’引导条件状语从句，将两个句子连接起来，注意‘if’在句中的大小写和位置。
29.answer: Check your work carefully if you do not want to make careless mistakes.
